hero.title: Automate Your Radio Content with AI
hero.subtitle: Generate scripts, create multi-speaker programs, synthesize professional audio, and schedule broadcasts — all powered by artificial intelligence.

features.title: Everything Your Station Needs
features.subtitle: A complete toolkit for modern radio content production, from script to broadcast.

aiScripts.title: AI Script Generation
aiScripts.desc: Create engaging radio scripts with Claude AI. Dialog formats, news digests, weather reports, and more — all customizable with your station's voice and style.

multiSpeaker.title: Multi-Speaker Programs
multiSpeaker.desc: Generate scripts for multiple hosts with distinct personalities. Each speaker gets unique lines with emotion tags for natural-sounding conversations.

tts.title: Text-to-Speech Audio
tts.desc: Convert scripts to professional audio using ElevenLabs voices. Support for multiple voices, emotion control, and automatic audio concatenation.

scheduling.title: Smart Scheduling
scheduling.desc: Flexible per-day schedule templates with host rotation. Set up time slots, assign voices, and let the system handle the rest.

ads.title: Ad Production
ads.desc: Create radio advertisements with AI. Multiple script variants, sponsor integration, background music mixing, and batch production.

cloud.title: Cloud Storage
cloud.desc: Automatic upload of generated audio to cloud storage. Organized folder structure with customizable naming templates.

shows.title: Show Management
shows.desc: Manage multiple program types with independent settings. Each show type has its own prompt, schedule, and voice configuration.

multilang.title: Multilingual Interface
multilang.desc: Full interface support for Russian, English, and Turkish. Auto-detection of user language with manual override.

automation.title: Full Automation
automation.desc: Set it and forget it. Auto-generate scripts, voice them, and upload to cloud on a customizable schedule. Pipeline runs hourly.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to automate your radio content production.

step1.title: Configure Your Station
step1.desc: Set up your station profile, add AI voices, define show types and schedule templates. Customize prompts for your unique style.

step2.title: Generate Content
step2.desc: AI creates scripts based on your prompts, current events, and station context. Review, edit, or regenerate with one click.

step3.title: Broadcast Automatically
step3.desc: Scripts are voiced, processed, and uploaded to your cloud storage automatically. Ready for your broadcast system.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your station. Scale as you grow.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Radio?
cta.subtitle: Join radio stations worldwide that trust RadioFlow AI to create engaging content automatically.
